title: Is ITC stock nearing the end of a 21-month correction? Bajaj Broking sees a 14% rally in 6 months
summary: Bajaj Broking anticipates ITC stock to rise towards ₹330, supported by a favorable risk-reward setup at a key support level. The stock has shown positive momentum, suggesting an investment opportunity in the next six months with a projected return of 14%.
